policy: Review the pinned TeX mathematics by source location and expanded model semantics. Lean declaration names route evidence but do not establish source fidelity.

Do not turn a missing source proof step into an unnamed theorem premise. Positive sample rates and conditional IID ratings are author-confirmed governing additions recorded above; the nontrivial rating scale and extended-rate codomain remain explicit corrections, and none is silently attributed to the pinned archive.

The literal mu_k recurrence, uniform type-population conditioning, and real-only rate display remain archival deltas. The checked finite IID results formalize the author-approved corrected model, not evidence that those literal source gaps disappeared.

Every defect records whether the governing result repairs the issue or replaces it by an authorized correction, with a source anchor and conclusion relation. A later archive-equivalence repair must preserve those anchors and satisfy the recorded acceptance condition without relying on declaration names.
